preregistration.the_bar: tail_ext (the standing object; the incumbent is reference-only)
preregistration.tail_mass_gate: vs the FOIL (tail_ext), beyond-EVAL-grid deviation, strict fall; arm-movability proved at design time (guard-tested)

attribution.note: vs_incumbent_total = incumbent − eq_tail (cross-story continuity: the whole tail win); magnitude_channel = tail_ext − eq_tail (THE story contrast — what the successor estimator adds over the shipped exponential); conditioning_margin = pooled_eq − eq_tail (per-position conditioning's earn; informs the serving object).

instrument_verdict.reason: `nf_margin3_QB_crps`: 2 fold(s) < 4 — CSCV/PBO is UNDEFINED, so the §0.5 deflation requirement was not EVALUATED, let alone failed. No effect size and no gate choice fixes this; only more folds do.
instrument_verdict.retest_trigger: 2 more fold(s) — i.e. a window of 7 seasons

QB.pbo_state: UNDEFINED — CSCV resamples a FIELD; Layer B fields ONE pre-registered contrast, so there was no search to overfit. Reported as undefined, NOT as a failed deflation gate.
QB.reason: the point estimate is positive (+0.0011 CRPS) but the interval spans zero (CI95 [None, None]), fold wins are 2/2 against a required None, and p=None. Every statistical gate except PBO is REACHABLE at this design — the effect is simply smaller than this design can resolve.
QB.retest_trigger: ~2 half-season folds (≈1 seasons) for the DSR gate at the observed per-fold Sharpe 28.232 — i.e. CALENDAR-bound and far beyond any plausible window; ⛔ this is NOT a near-term re-test.
